defect: the ~300 s capture ceiling forces hand-rolled segmentation: s09 16:9 took 318.4 s, and s12 shipped two stream-copied 300-frame segments (8,328,762 + 8,776,080 B) as a 17,104,127 B final, bypassing the encoder settings and ending 43% over the 12 MB guidance
